correctness.rationale: For the explicitly labelled 18-edge Herschel graph, independently enumerated 124,346,658 augmented faces for cutoffs r=1,2,3, and acyclic greedy Morse matchings with the claimed critical dimensions (2 S2;10 S3;3 S4 and 1 S5). Our Hasse totals 338,1139,2525 exclude the 11 vertex-to-empty incidences; adding them gives package totals 349,1150,2536. Signed integer reduction confirms the r=3 top 3x1 attaching column is zero. Hurewicz removes the attaching ambiguity; target connectivity forces both stage inclusions nullhomotopic.
